good evening this matter concerns the
authorization to draft a fiscal year
2019 2020 CDBG action plan now as a
condition of receiving federal CDBG
funds from the US Department of Housing
and Urban Development the city is
required to prepare an annual action
plan which details the intended use of
the grant funds now prior to drafting a
plan the city is required to hold a
hearing to provide the opportunity for
the public to comment on the needs and
priorities on which the plan will be
based in May 2015 the City Council
approved the 2015 2020 consolidated plan
this is a five-year strategic and
visioning document which serves as a
basis for subsequent action plans
development of the consolidated plan
required the assessment and
prioritization

whether city plans to expend CDBG funds
to address a particular category of need
